draft.headline: An Anthropic study found 80% of 100 AI-built apps automate manual tasks to speed up output rather than cut costs.
draft.threads_post:
80% of 100 AI-built apps focus on automating manual tasks, according to a new Anthropic study.

The research shows most AI deployments derive value by expanding and accelerating output rather than cutting costs. Businesses are using AI to speed up work, while navigating adoption bottlenecks across the economy.

Should companies focus AI on speeding up output or cutting costs?
